editor.info.help_text:
# How to draw

You can drag an icon onto the canvas.
A double click on an empty spot places the chosen element (or a block),
a single click drops the tool; a double click on a card edits its title.
Arrow: drag from the edge of a block to another block.
Hold space — the canvas follows the mouse.

## Keys
  ⌘C — copy
  ⌘V — paste
  ⌘D — duplicate
  ⌘Z — undo
  ⌘G — group
